verdict.summary: The prior round's order concern is resolved by the demonstrated claim/adopt contract: FIX_CHAIN order controls allocator preference before launch, while review-fix.yml receives a ladder-floor representation only to reconstruct the authorized membership set and adopt the already-selected SHA/claim-bound model. The adopt path does not independently choose from that reconstructed sequence; it rejects any claimed model outside it. The new full-chain test covers the formerly missing live OpenAI case and proves that the floor expansion contains exactly the claimed tiers, while the singleton/non-suffix tests prove excluded tiers are not readmitted. The implementation re-resolves the source issue's live labels through the registry policy resolver, intersects fail-closed with the provider fix walk, distinguishes escalation from defer on empty intersections, refuses unrepresentable constraints, and leaves cross-provider review dispatch independent. The wiring and end-to-end tests are non-vacuous and cover resolver failure, empty intersections, ladder-floor widening, transmitted model_pin, and live routing rows.
